# Nofakey.ai

> A free, privacy-first tool that checks WhatsApp messages, emails, and news
> text for common scam and misinformation wording patterns. Not a full
> fact-checking service — a fast first-pass filter, plus guides that help
> people verify claims themselves.

## Pages
- [Home](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/): Free spam & fake news checker
- [Blog](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog.html): Guides on spotting fake news and scams
- [About](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/about.html): What Nofakey.ai is and isn't
- [Contact](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/contact.html): Get in touch

## Blog posts
- [How to Check If a Charity Donation Request Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-charity-donation-request-is-a-scam.html): A donation appeal with an urgent story and a payment link arrived unexpectedly? Here's how to tell a real charity request from a scam.
- [How to Check If an Insurance Policy Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-an-insurance-policy-message-is-fake.html): A text claims your insurance policy matured with a bonus, or is about to lapse unless you pay a fee? Here's how to tell if it's real.
- [How to Check If a WhatsApp Verification Code Request Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-whatsapp-verification-code-request-is-a-scam.html): A contact asks you to share a 6-digit WhatsApp code they 'accidentally' received? Here's how this account takeover scam works and how to stop it.
- [What Is a Digital Arrest Scam? How to Protect Yourself](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/what-is-a-digital-arrest-scam.html): A call claims you're under investigation and must stay on the line or face arrest? Here's why 'digital arrest' isn't real, and how to protect yourself.
- [How to Report a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-report-a-scam.html): What to do immediately after a scam attempt, including how to report cyber fraud in India through the official cybercrime portal and helpline.
- [What Is Phishing? A Complete Guide](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/what-is-phishing.html): A clear explanation of what phishing actually is, the different forms it takes — email, SMS, calls, QR codes — and how to protect yourself from all of them.
- [How to Avoid Scams: A Complete Safety Checklist](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-avoid-scams.html): A practical, memorable set of habits that protect you against nearly every type of scam, from urgency tactics to OTP requests to fake payment links.
- [Types of Online Scams (and How to Spot Each One)](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/types-of-online-scams.html): A complete overview of the main types of online scams — message impersonation, payment-first tricks, SIM takeovers, fake sites, and more — with links to a detailed guide for each.
- [How to Check If a Call Forwarding Code Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-call-forwarding-code-message-is-a-scam.html): Asked to dial a code starting with * or # to 'fix' your network or unlock a free service? Here's how to tell if it's a call forwarding scam.
- [How to Check If a Duplicate SIM Card Request Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-duplicate-sim-card-request-is-a-scam.html): Worried someone could get a replacement SIM in your name? Here's how duplicate SIM scams work and how to protect yourself.
- [How to Check If a Missed Call from an Unknown Number Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-missed-call-from-an-unknown-number-is-a-scam.html): A single ring, then a missed call from a number you don't recognize? Here's how to tell if it's a one-ring scam before you call back.
- [How to Check If a Mobile Number Port Request Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-mobile-number-port-request-is-a-scam.html): Received a porting verification code you didn't request? Here's how mobile number port (MNP) scams work and how to stop one.
- [How to Check If a SIM Card Upgrade Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-sim-card-upgrade-message-is-fake.html): A message or call asks you to share an OTP to upgrade your SIM? Here's how to tell a real network upgrade from a SIM swap scam.
- [How to Check If a UPI Payment Request Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-upi-payment-request-is-a-scam.html): Got an unexpected UPI collect request asking you to enter your PIN to 'receive' money? Here's how to tell if it's a scam.
- [How to Check If a FASTag or Toll Tax Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-fastag-or-toll-tax-message-is-fake.html): A text says your FASTag KYC is incomplete or a toll payment is pending? Here's how to tell a real FASTag message from a scam.
- [How to Check If an Electricity Bill Disconnection Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-an-electricity-bill-disconnection-message-is-fake.html): A text threatens to cut your power tonight unless you pay through a link? Here's how to tell a real disconnection notice from a scam.
- [How to Check If a QR Code Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-qr-code-is-a-scam.html): Scanned a QR code and something feels off? Here's how to tell a real QR code from a scam before you enter any details.
- [How to Check If a Tech Support Pop-up Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-tech-support-pop-up-is-a-scam.html): A pop-up says your device is infected and gives you a number to call? Here's how to tell a real security warning from a scam.
- [How to Check If a Dating Profile Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-dating-profile-is-fake.html): A new match feels a little too perfect, a little too fast? Here's how to tell a real dating or matrimonial profile from a fake one.
- [How to Check If a Government Scheme Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-government-scheme-message-is-fake.html): A text claims you're eligible for a government scheme or subsidy if you pay a small fee first? Here's how to tell if it's real.
- [How to Check If a Shopping Website Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-shopping-website-is-fake.html): A deal looks amazing but you've never heard of the store? Here's how to check if a shopping website is fake before you enter your card details.
- [How to Check If an Investment Tip Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-an-investment-tip-is-a-scam.html): A WhatsApp contact or group is promising big, steady returns on an investment? Here's how to tell a real opportunity from a scam.
- [How to Check If a Customer Care Number Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-customer-care-number-is-fake.html): Found a helpline number through a search or ad and something feels off? Here's how to tell a real customer care line from a scam.
- [How to Check If a Loan Offer Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-loan-offer-message-is-a-scam.html): A text says you're pre-approved for an instant loan if you pay a small fee first? Here's how to tell a real loan offer from a scam.
- [How to Check If a Bank Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-bank-message-is-fake.html): Got a text saying your bank account will be blocked unless you 'update KYC' right now? Here's how to tell if a bank message is real or a scam.
- [How to Check If a Delivery Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-delivery-message-is-a-scam.html): A text says your parcel is stuck and needs a small fee to be released? Here's how to tell a real delivery notice from a scam before you pay anything.
- [How to Check If a Job Offer Message Is a Scam](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-job-offer-message-is-a-scam.html): Got an unexpected job offer on WhatsApp or email? Here's how to tell a real opportunity from a scam before you hand over any money or details.
- [How to Check If a Lottery or Prize Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-lottery-or-prize-message-is-fake.html): A message says you've won a lottery, gift card, or prize you don't remember entering? Here's how to tell if it's real before you respond.
- [How to Check If a WhatsApp Message Is Fake](https://nofakey-ai.github.io/blog/how-to-check-if-a-whatsapp-message-is-fake.html): A practical, no-jargon checklist for spotting fake WhatsApp forwards and scam messages before you share or act on them.
